title: Shin Megami Tensei: Digital Devil Saga (USA, SLUS_209.74), ee-gcc 2.96
setup: mkdir -p tools/compilers tools/bin orig/dds1 && ln -sfn {tool:ee-gcc2.96} tools/compilers/ee-gcc2.96 && for t in as ld objcopy; do ln -sf {tool:binutils-mips-ps2-decompals}/mips-ps2-decompals-$t tools/bin/mips-ps2-decompals-$t; done && ln -sf {tool:objdiff-cli}/objdiff-cli tools/bin/objdiff-cli && ln -sf {retail} orig/dds1/SLUS_209.74
limits: Pinned compiler: toolchains.json `ee-gcc2.96` (decomp.me build), run unpatched under `setarch -R` with the repo's own `-O2` cc1 and EE assembler flags; the repo's download_tools.py ASLR/assembler patches are not applied, so the matched set can be smaller than the repo's own count.
Units are compiled with the repo's own command (ninja compdb), the `cpp -MM` dependency step and the production-report recorder dropped.

cross_check.what: the repo's own link (`ninja dds1`) with the pinned compiler
